name: nexus_get_tags
description:
Get the mod tag taxonomy of a game via v2 GraphQL [v2 - no v1 quota].

Useful to build tag filters for nexus_search_mods.

Returns:
    JSON list [{id, name, parentId, global, blockable, searchable}].

domain_name.description: Nexus Mods game domain (lowercase URL slug), e.g. 'forzahorizon6', 'skyrimse'. NOT the display name.
domain_name.title: Domain Name

exclude_adult.description: If true, exclude adult-content tags from results.
exclude_adult.title: Exclude Adult

only_adult.description: If true, return only adult-content tags.
only_adult.title: Only Adult
